mapper.select: SELECT noti_seq AS noti_seq, noti_type_cd AS noti_type_cd, title AS title, content AS content, TO_CHAR(start_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_dt, TO_CHAR(end_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_dt, COALESCE(pin_yn, 'N') AS pin_yn, COALESCE(popup_yn, 'N') AS popup_yn, COALESCE(view_cnt, 0) AS view_cnt, COALESCE(use_yn, 'Y') AS use_yn, TO_CHAR(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updated_at, updated_by AS updated_by, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at, created_by AS created_by FROM adm_noti_mst WHERE noti_seq = #{notiSeq}
mapper.insert:
SELECT nextval('adm_noti_mst_seq')
INSERT INTO adm_noti_mst ( noti_seq, noti_type_cd, title, content, start_dt, end_dt, pin_yn, popup_yn, view_cnt, use_yn, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{noti_seq}, #{noti_type_cd}, #{title}, #{content}, CASE WHEN #{start_dt} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{start_dt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END, CASE WHEN #{end_dt} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{end_dt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END, COALESCE(#{pin_yn}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{popup_yn}, 'N'), 0, COALESCE(#{use_yn}, 'Y'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{created_by}, NULL, NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE adm_noti_mst SET noti_type_cd = #{noti_type_cd}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, start_dt = CASE WHEN #{start_dt} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{start_dt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END, end_dt = CASE WHEN #{end_dt} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{end_dt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END, pin_yn = COALESCE(#{pin_yn}, 'N'), popup_yn = COALESCE(#{popup_yn}, 'N'), use_yn = COALESCE(#{use_yn}, 'Y'), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updated_by} WHERE noti_seq = #{noti_seq}
